description: ADR-0121 D11 / S2 P2 plan-exactness corpus (schema: docs/plans/agent-plan-corpus-schema.md). Agent-drafted 2026-10-20 in batches of about 60 (AP-1..AP-N). The owner reviewed every batch on 2026-10-21 (review sheet docs/plans/agent-plan-review.md): the cases marked ok are approved; the fixed ones, the held ones (decisions (d) and (e)) and the unreviewed one stay pending. Positives are multi-step plans whose gold is the exact step graph (Q10); negatives are none (any executable plan is wrong), some with the tempting plan as a trap the validator must refuse; the unbounded negatives expect an ask with a bounded suggestion (decision (h)), their trap the unbounded plan Core turns into it. The one-step gold (Q11) is every nl-intent.v1.json case, referenced by id and never copied.
